name: LLM-GLOBE
description: Immense effort has been dedicated to minimizing the presence of harmful or biased generative content and better aligning AI output to human intention; however, research investigating the cultural values of LLMs is still in very early stages. Cultural values underpin how societies operate, providing profound insights into the norms, priorities, and decision making of their members. In recognition of this need for further research, we draw upon cultural psychology theory and the empirically-validated GLOBE framework to propose the LLM-GLOBE benchmark for evaluating the cultural value systems of LLMs, and we then leverage the benchmark to compare the values of Chinese and US LLMs. Our methodology includes a novel "LLMs-as-a-Jury" pipeline which automates the evaluation of open-ended content to enable large-scale analysis at a conceptual level. reputation: A very recent benchmark with early-stage adoption, mainly of interest to researchers studying cultural alignment and value modeling in LLMs.
notes: Open-ended cultural-value evaluation using an LLMs-as-a-Jury pipeline; benchmark is new and likely to evolve, with potential judge-bias and prompt-sensitivity concerns.
